# hf-mcp-server

> A Model Context Protocol server that connects LLMs to the Hugging Face Hub and thousands of Gradio AI applications, installable in Claude, Gemini CLI, VSCode, and Cursor.

Written in TypeScript and managed with pnpm; runs locally via npx or Docker with STDIO or StreamableHTTP (JSON mode) transports, defaulting to port 3000. The repo contains /mcp (Hub API and search MCP implementations) and /app (the MCP server and web application with a /metrics dashboard). Configure tools and Spaces at huggingface.co/settings/mcp; HTTP clients authenticate with a Hugging Face token in the Authorization Bearer header.

## Docs

- [hf-mcp-server README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/huggingface/hf-mcp-server/main/README.md): Installation instructions for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, VSCode and Cursor, plus tool configuration.
- [Agents test](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/huggingface/hf-mcp-server/main/AGENTS-test.md): Guidance on rendering tool-returned links as clickable markdown.
- [Gradio Endpoint Discovery Optimization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/huggingface/hf-mcp-server/main/GRADIO_DISCOVERY_OPTIMIZATION.md): Two-level caching of Gradio space metadata and schemas to speed up stateless HTTP discovery.
- [Benchmarking and optimization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/huggingface/hf-mcp-server/main/docs/benchmarking.md): Where benchmark harnesses and production-log analysis live, and how to publish reproducible results.
- [OAuth and CIMD diagnostics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/huggingface/hf-mcp-server/main/docs/oauth-diagnostics.md): Running a local OAuth client against Hugging Face, with dynamic registration, CIMD mode and scope-limited diagnostics.
- [Space Monitor Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/huggingface/hf-mcp-server/main/docs/space-monitor-architecture.md): How the scheduled Space monitor observes Spaces, repairs failing revisions, and manages its ledger and credentials.
